title.zh: 央行调一个利率，为什么所有东西的价格都跟着动
title.en: Why One Interest Rate Moves the Price of Everything

desc.zh: 从折现出发，走到债券久期、收益率曲线、准备金与地板体系、泰勒规则、新凯恩斯模型、股票房价汇率、量化宽松和 r − g，最后是 2026 年底各大央行的位置与争论。十三个可以拖动的模型。
desc.en: From discounting to bond duration, the yield curve, reserves and the floor system, the Taylor rule, the New Keynesian model, stocks, houses and exchange rates, QE and r − g, ending with where the major central banks stand in late 2026. Thirteen models you can push.

desc.zh: 未来的一串钱今天值多少；钱离得越远，现值对利率越敏感。
desc.en: What a stream of future money is worth today; the further away the money, the more its value reacts to the rate.

zh: 为什么利率越高资产越便宜
en: what is future money worth today
why do higher rates lower prices

desc.zh: 收益率升 1 个点，债券约跌“修正久期”个百分点；凸性修正弯曲。2022 年的长债下跌和硅谷银行。
desc.en: A one-point rise in yield cuts a bond's price by about its modified duration; convexity corrects the curve. The 2022 bond rout and SVB.

zh: 利率上升债券为什么跌
为什么长期国债跌得多
en: why do bond prices fall when rates rise
why did silicon valley bank fail

title.zh: 收益率曲线、即期利率与远期利率
title.en: Yield curve, spot and forward rates

desc.zh: 从国债平价收益率自举出每一年的折现因子、零息利率和一年期远期利率。
desc.en: Bootstrapping Treasury par yields into discount factors, zero rates and one-year forward rates.

title.zh: 预期假说、期限溢价与收益率曲线倒挂
title.en: Expectations, term premium and yield-curve inversion

desc.zh: 长期利率 ≈ 预期短期利率的平均 + 期限溢价；1960 年以来倒挂与美国衰退的真实记录。
desc.en: Long rate ≈ average expected short rate + term premium; the actual US record of inversions and recessions since 1960.

en: does an inverted yield curve predict recession

title.zh: 准备金、利率走廊与地板体系
title.en: Reserves, the corridor and the floor system

desc.zh: Poole 模型：准备金需求曲线决定隔夜利率；稀缺时是走廊，充裕时贴在准备金利率的地板上。
desc.en: The Poole model: the reserve demand curve sets the overnight rate; scarce reserves give a corridor, ample reserves a floor at the interest on reserves.

en: how does the central bank set interest rates

title.zh: 泰勒规则与自然利率 r*
title.en: The Taylor rule and the neutral rate r*

desc.zh: 用 1990–2026 年的真实数据对照泰勒规则；r* 的估计有多不确定。
desc.en: The Taylor rule against real 1990–2026 data; how uncertain the estimates of r* are.

en: how high should interest rates be

title.zh: 新凯恩斯模型与菲利普斯曲线
title.en: The New Keynesian model and the Phillips curve

desc.zh: 三方程模型：需求冲击可以被利率抵消，供给冲击只能在通胀和产出间取舍；泰勒原则与菲利普斯曲线斜率之争。
desc.en: The three-equation model: demand shocks can be offset, supply shocks force a trade-off; the Taylor principle and the debate over the Phillips curve's slope.

en: how do rate hikes lower inflation

title.zh: 股票久期与房贷可负担性

desc.zh: 两段式股利折现模型里成长股久期更长；同样月供下，利率决定能借多少。
desc.en: In a two-stage dividend discount model growth stocks have longer duration; for the same monthly payment the rate decides how much you can borrow.

en: why do growth stocks fall when rates rise
do higher rates lower house prices

title.en: Interest parity and the carry trade

desc.zh: 抛补利率平价决定远期汇率；非抛补利率平价在数据里常常失效，套利交易平时赚、偶尔大亏。
desc.en: Covered parity sets the forward rate; uncovered parity often fails in the data, and the carry trade earns steadily then crashes.

en: why does a rate hike strengthen the currency

title.zh: 零利率下限、前瞻指引与量化宽松
title.en: Zero lower bound, forward guidance and QE

desc.zh: 利率到零后，承诺和买债怎样压低长期利率；Gagnon 等 2011 年的估计范围；缩表。
desc.en: How promises and bond purchases lower long rates once the short rate hits zero; the Gagnon et al. 2011 estimates; quantitative tightening.

title.zh: 政府债务动态与 r − g
title.en: Government debt dynamics and r − g

desc.zh: 债务占 GDP 比例由利率与增长率之差和基本盈余决定；加息怎样几年后传到政府的利息账单。
desc.en: The debt ratio is driven by the gap between the interest rate and growth plus the primary balance; how rate hikes reach the government's interest bill over years.

title.zh: 2026 年底的主要央行与仍在争论的问题
title.en: Major central banks in late 2026 and the open debates

desc.zh: 美联储、欧洲央行、英格兰银行、日本银行、中国人民银行的利率与资产负债表；框架评估、r*、数字欧元。
desc.en: Policy rates and balance sheets of the Fed, ECB, Bank of England, Bank of Japan and PBoC; framework reviews, r*, the digital euro.
